scope: Read-only source audit paired with the exact-stamp #330 odometry and same-epoch occupancy snapshot.

self_geometry_overlap.box_center_frame: d435i_link; the SDF IMU translation is [0,0,0] in this link
self_geometry_overlap.interpretation: The unknown cell contains the modeled D435i housing center, so writing the whole cell as ordinary free would also label a cell containing self geometry as free. This supports requiring an explicit self-filter/footprint semantic.

source_mechanism.map_initialization: Unwritten occupancy cells initialize below the unknown threshold.
source_mechanism.ray_start_and_end: raycastProcess passes projected surface point as RayCaster start and camera position as end.
source_mechanism.endpoint_behavior: RayCaster::step assigns the current voxel to ray_pt, then returns false when it equals the end voxel. raycastProcess calls setCacheOccupancy(..., 0) only inside the while loop for successful steps.
source_mechanism.effect: Each depth ray skips the camera-endpoint voxel in its miss/free updates; absent another update path, the camera-origin voxel remains unknown. The paired #330 snapshot shows that this same voxel is unknown at the planner start sample.

interpretation: The exact-stamp odometry, SDF-derived D435i extrinsic, planner start sample, and #330 map snapshot all resolve to voxel [120,122,1]. The pinned EGO source leaves the ray endpoint voxel out of free-space updates, providing a strong source-supported explanation for the repeated t=0 unknown rejection in this run.
limitations: This is a read-only source/runtime alignment audit, not an intervention; it does not prove sole causality or explain all 58 nonzero-time first-block samples in #330.
The occupancy snapshot is the online planner map, not independent ground truth. An unknown voxel is not demonstrated to be physically free.
No source patch, package build, new runtime, trajectory execution, vehicle sweep, controller, PX4, truth input, or flight validation was performed.
The D435i SDF collision box center lies in this cell. Clearing it as ordinary free would need an explicit self-filter/footprint contract and separate safety review.
